headline: Week 8: Kyle Dech Brings a Knife to a Bazooka Fight
subhead: T swift's Baddies didn't beat Put an AR to My Head — they filed a missing persons report on him.
matchOfTheWeek: The Good Ladds squeaked past The Olave Garden 177.80 to 173.86 in a 350-point shootout where Ladd McConkey (29.10) finally justified the team name and Patrick had to watch Travis Kelce drop 30 in a loss. Mig also imported Kareem Hunt mid-week from LargestofRocks for picks, then watched Tyrone Tracy go full bus on his bench for 23. Winning by 3.94 with that much left on the table is the fantasy equivalent of finishing a beer pong game with cup water in your mouth — a W is a W, but everyone saw it.
powerRankingsShakeup: 226 Alpha and LargestofRocks both cleared 178 and look like the class of the league, while Put an AR to My Head is now begging the title to be taken literally.
mainRecap:
KyleDech, buddy. 91.90 points. In a SuperFlex league. With IDPs. That's not a fantasy score, that's a co-pay. T swift's Baddies dropped 179.30 on you and didn't even need Jameis Winston's 23.56 from the bench to do it — Kirk Cousins (28.64) and James Cook (28.30) handled it like adults while you sat there with your AR pointed in the only logical direction.

LargestofRocks unleashed CeeDee Lamb for 39.60 and put 178 on Jets' Juniors, who managed a Wunder-ful 124.20. Mattwunder, your roster looks like a taxi squad that wandered into the starting lineup by accident. Meanwhile Largest decided mid-blowout to ship Kareem Hunt to The Good Ladds for picks — collecting draft capital while already winning by 54 is just bullying with a spreadsheet.

226 Alpha posted the week's high (184.66) behind Jalen Hurts (35.14) and a Cade Otton (33.60) game that nobody on Earth predicted, then somehow still left Cedric Tillman (28.90) AND Matthew Stafford (25.76) rotting on the bench. Szara could've scored 240 and is mad about it. Hot Cocks ate the loss but BigD set the league record for self-sabotage with 41.72 bench points wasted — Kittle went for 27.80 and you still found a way to leave a buffet untouched.

OnlyFants ran a 99.2% efficient lineup against MassiveCocks, which is the most clinical Cubby has looked all year and somehow the most embarrassing way to lose for 7BigPapi7. Stroud Boys handled Bo Nix Celli 149-128 in the battle of QB-named franchises, with Bo Nix himself going for 29.76 in his own owner's loss — Nick, your team is literally named after the guy actively beating you. And Justin Herbert dropped 24.06 on your bench just to twist it.

weeklyAwards.title: War Crime of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: Beating a man 179 to 91 should require a Geneva Convention review.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Hoarder Hall of Fame
weeklyAwards.blurb: 41.72 points left on the pine — BigD is running a fantasy team and a witness protection program simultaneously.

weeklyAwards.title: Stat-Padder of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: CeeDee Lamb 39.60, a 54-point win, AND extracted picks from Mig in the same week — pure profit margin behavior.

weeklyAwards.title: Pyrrhic L Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: 173.86 with a 30-point Kelce and still loses by a field goal — endless breadsticks, zero wins.
